d: A youth with a petite build, featuring muted lavender hair styled with blunt-cut bangs and a long, single side- ponytail. The expression is irritable with sharp, narrow eyes of a matching muted lavender shade. This individual wears a white sailor-style top with navy blue trim and a navy blue pleated skirt, paired with large, dark grey mechanical armor pieces attached to the legs and a massive, dark grey naval armament structure strapped to the back. A small red flower accessory is pinned into the hair near the temple.
